query.description: The SQL SELECT query to execute against the CRM tables.

out.description: Deliver the FULL result as a downloadable file instead of inline rows, and return a short-lived URL. There is no row limit on this path — curl it to disk and analyse it locally with jq/python. Use it for anything you would otherwise LIMIT just to fit.

format.description: File format when `out` is true. Default jsonl (one record per line) — prefer it, because CRM text contains newlines and line-based tools miscount CSV rows. csv for spreadsheets.

user_request_summary.description: One sentence, in your own words: what the user actually asked you to do in this turn. Used only for Cedar's observability — it does not change what this tool does.

is_new_request.description: true on the FIRST Cedar tool call of a NEW user request; false when this call continues the same request you are already working on. Groups related calls into one activity thread.
